videos.title: BALI Travel Guide 2026 — hidden gems only
I lived in Ubud for a month — everything worth doing

spots.name: Tegallalang Rice Terrace
spots.description: Iconic stepped rice paddies just north of Ubud. Both creators say go before 8am to beat the crowds and the heat — the morning light on the terraces is unreal.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI Travel Guide 2026 — hidden gems only
mentions.quote: If you only see one rice terrace in Bali, make it this one — but come at sunrise.

mentions.videoTitle: I lived in Ubud for a month — everything worth doing
mentions.quote: Honestly overhyped at noon, magical at 7am. Trust me on this.

spots.name: Suwat Waterfall
spots.description: A quieter waterfall near Gianyar with a natural pool you can actually swim in. Far fewer tourists than Tegenungan.

mentions.videoTitle: I lived in Ubud for a month — everything worth doing
mentions.quote: We had the whole waterfall to ourselves on a Tuesday morning.

spots.name: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka
spots.description: Legendary suckling pig warung in central Ubud. Go hungry and go early — they regularly sell out by mid-afternoon.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI Travel Guide 2026 — hidden gems only
mentions.quote: Best babi guling of the entire trip, no contest.

spots.name: Villa Kelusa Pondok
spots.description: A jungle villa 15 minutes north of Ubud with a private infinity pool overlooking the river valley. Mia stayed here for four nights and called it the best Airbnb she's booked in Asia.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI Travel Guide 2026 — hidden gems only
mentions.quote: Waking up to that pool view every morning was worth every rupiah.

spots.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk
spots.description: A free, easy ridge-top walk through palm hills starting right in Ubud town. Best at golden hour; both creators filmed their intros here.

mentions.videoTitle: BALI Travel Guide 2026 — hidden gems only
mentions.quote: It's free, it's gorgeous, there's zero excuse to skip it.

mentions.videoTitle: I lived in Ubud for a month — everything worth doing
mentions.quote: I walked this ridge basically every evening I was in Ubud.
